abilities.name: Summon Gladewyrm
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gladewyrm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gladewyrm** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.effectPlain: Set up a Gladewyrm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Comet's Call
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Light of Chotec
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Seraphon^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 4+, **Heal (1)** the target.

abilities.name: The Earth Trembles
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them to be the target point, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line between the target point and the closest part on the caster's base. Roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) that has models passed across by this line. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.effectPlain: Draw a straight line between the target point and the closest part on the caster's base. Roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) that has models passed across by this line. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Song Of The Lost
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not a **^^Monster^^**, ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.
abilities.effectPlain:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can Heal (3) the target.
• If the target is not a Monster, ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Song Of Dread
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick an enemy unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a **^^Move^^** ability and ends that move within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after that **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.
abilities.effectPlain: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a Move ability and ends that move within the creeping overgrowth, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after that Move ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Song Of War
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.
abilities.effectPlain: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.
